added.title: Director of Engineering
added.description:
Position: Director of Engineering/Product Development

Location: Spartanburg, SC

Salary: $225k - $275k + Bonus

Growing HVAC Company is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead their team!

RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership & Team Management
: Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing engineering team, including both local and overseas staff.
Product Development
: Lead the end-to-end product development process, from concept through launch, ensuring innovative, efficient, and cost-effective HVAC & Thermal Systems Engineering and Manufacturing
New Product Innovation
: Spearhead new product development initiatives to meet market demands and align with business objectives.
Global Collaboration
: Coordinate with international partners in Asia and domestic stakeholders to optimize product design, manufacturing processes, and supply chain efficiency.
Design & Modeling
: Oversee product design, system and component modeling, performance simulation, and prototype development.
Testing & Analysis
: Develop and implement testing protocols to ensure product performance, reliability, and compliance with industry standards.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
: Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations, and external vendors to meet technical specifications and business goals.
Regulatory Compliance
: Manage product certifications and compliance, including AHRI, DOE, ETL, UL, and other relevant standards.
Cost Optimization
: Identify and implement cost-saving initiatives for existing and new product lines without compromising quality or performance.
Documentation & Quality Assurance
: Ensure thorough documentation of design processes and establish robust quality assurance protocols.

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field (advanced degrees preferred).
Minimum of 10 years in HVAC engineering and product development, with a focus on water-source and air-cooled products.
In-depth knowledge of terminal HVAC systems, including refrigeration components, air handling systems, wiring and controls, sheet metal design, piping, and valves.
Proficiency in SolidWorks, CAD, and similar engineering tools, with an understanding of AI-powered tools for design automation, performance modeling, and predictive maintenance.
Experience working with international teams and suppliers, particularly in Asia.
Domestic and international travel required (approximately 5-10%).

added.title: Director of Engineering
added.description:
Role and Responsibilities

The candidate will lead the engineering organization for a top contract manufacturer in the additive manufacturing industry, primarily focused on laser powder bed fusion and turnkey manufacturing support for customer-designed components.
The Director of Engineering is responsible for the strategic vision of the engineering team, aligning processes, tools, and innovation with the overall company growth plans. Due to the breadth of manufacturing scope we handle, this role requires considerable background knowledge in powder bed fusion, post-processing, heat treating, destructive and non-destructive testing, and finishing methods.
The ideal candidate has experience in a production environment, balancing safety, quality, cost, execution, and innovation to create an environment for company success and sustainable growth. Excellent interpersonal skills are critical for properly communicating with customers and internal stakeholders.
As a small business, this position requires the flexibility to seamlessly move from board room to production floor to address priorities.
Key focus areas for this position include:
Shaping the strategy of the company with input on industry trends and technology advancements
Supporting business development by serving customers well with technical support
Defining and optimizing engineering processes to enable consistent and efficient execution of work
Promoting continuous improvement, on-time delivery, and quality output
Solving problems as they arise with a collaborative approach
Driving innovation through industry/academic partnerships, consortiums, and internal R&D

Engineering and Manufacturing

Lead a team of Additive Manufacturing Engineers and Production Engineers through quoting, digital order loading, process definition, and technical support for production. This scope includes:
Assess design for manufacturability, material selection, equipment selection, and design optimization
Guide customers in the selection of materials
Develop content and best practices for design and manufacturability by establishing design guidelines to ensure lessons learned and best practices are documented
Create build files, layouts, and use cost estimation models
Prepare bills of material (BOM) and routings in an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system
Lead and provide technical direction for technicians
Provide "hands-on" support with printing and inspection equipment
Manage acquisition of necessary capital, maintenance contracts, consumables, and software to support growth strategies
Read and understand dimensional drawings, including GD&T
Analyze and specify post-processing steps such as heat treatment, finish machining, and coatings
Support and guide the root cause and corrective action (RCCA) process for technical issues

Customer Programs

Promote growth with key customers, new parts, and new industries by leading and supporting New Product Introduction (NPI).
Focus technology and process development to enable high-volume production.
Support the Project Management team in the following ways:
Assist in assembling quotations in response to customer RFQ's
Lead customer projects as the assigned project engineer
Prepare project schedules to define project scope deliverables
Lead and/or participate in regular customer meetings
Monitor and manage project costs in respect to the established budget
Anticipate problems and concerns relevant to project management and provide timely solutions
Coordinate document submittals, approvals, distribution, and revision control
Initiate purchase requisitions for tools, fixtures, operational equipment, and outside services
Maintain a strong working relationship with the customer
Occasional travel may be required to support project or program goals

Engineering Technical Programs / R&D

Lead advanced technical engineering programs (material/product/process development)
Lead statistical process control initiatives
Lead operational and supply chain cost reduction and optimization projects
Provide guidance on facility improvements, equipment selection, and in-sourcing

Qualifications And Education Requirements

Engineering degree in a related discipline (additive manufacturing, mechanical, metallurgical, etc.)
Minimum 12 years of experience in a production environment, including additive manufacturing, CNC machining, heat treating, and/or other metal fabrications technologies.
Prior experience must include technical roles and senior-level decision making roles with budget control.
Experience with the following software: CAD (e.g. SolidWorks, Catia), Build Preparation/Slice software (e.g. Materialise Magics, 3DExpert), Microsoft Office Suite
This position is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) which requires U.S. person status. ITAR defines U.S. person as an U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (i.e. 'Green Card Holder'), Political Asylee, or Refugee.
Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Preferred Additional Qualifications And Education

Masters or PhD in additive manufacturing or related engineering discipline
Previous experience working for a Contract Manufacturer in laser powder bed fusion
Experience with ISO 9001 and/or AS9100 Revision D

added.title: Sr. Design Engineering Manager
added.description:
Full-time Description

American Plastics, headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, is a leading designer and manufacturer of innovative plastic-injection molded products for the household & garage storage and commercial cleaning end-markets.

We are seeking a skilled Sr. Design Engineer specializing in plastics to join our team at our NEW Innovation Center, in Jefferson City, MO. This position will lead a team of design engineers and will be responsible for designing and developing plastic components and products, ensuring functionality, manufacturability, and cost-effectiveness. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams, utilizing CAD software, and staying updated on industry trends and technologies. This position will report to the Vice President of Engineering.

Product Design: Conceptualize, design, and develop plastic components and products according to project requirements, considering factors such as functionality, aesthetics, manufacturability, and cost-effectiveness.
CAD Modeling: Utilize CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, CATIA) to create detailed 3D models and 2D drawings of plastic parts and assemblies.
Prototyping: Oversee the prototyping process, including selecting appropriate materials, collaborating with prototype technicians, and validating designs for fit, form, and function.
Material Selection: Evaluate and select suitable plastic materials based on performance requirements, environmental factors, and cost considerations.
Design Optimization: Continuously improve designs for efficiency, performance, and cost reduction through analysis, simulation, and testing.
Manufacturability: Collaborate with manufacturing teams to ensure designs are optimized for production processes such as injection molding, extrusion, and thermoforming.
Quality Assurance: Work closely with quality control teams to establish and implement quality standards for plastic components and products, ensuring compliance with industry regulations.
Documentation: Prepare and maintain comprehensive design documentation, including technical drawings, specifications, and design change records.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including product management, manufacturing, quality assurance, and procurement to achieve project goals and deadlines.
Research and Innovation: Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in plastic design, and incorporate innovative solutions into product development processes.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or plastics Engineering
Excellent at leading and developing a team
Experience of hands-on injection molding experience a plus.
7 + Years experience with Product Design of plastic injection molded products
SolidWorks knowledge.
Experience with prototyping techniques and rapid iteration processes.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Effective communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work in cross-functional teams.
Familiarity with design for manufacturability (DFM) and design for assembly (DFA) principles.
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Strong communication skills.

If you are interested in joining the American Plastics team and want to work in a fast-paced, progressive environment, we want to hear from you. We offer a competitive salary, full benefit package including medical/dental, 401k, and paid vacation.

added.description:
Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead the company's global Technology organization and define the technology strategy, engineering direction, innovation agenda, and long-term technical capabilities.

The CTO will translate business objectives into a scalable technology strategy and work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Security, Finance, and Executive Leadership to build reliable, secure, and high-performing technology platforms.

The role will oversee Software Engineering, Technology Architecture, Cloud Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Data & Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, DevOps, IT Operations, Systems Integration, Technology Innovation, and Technology Governance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technology Strategy & Vision

Develop and execute the company's long-term technology strategy.

Align technology investments with corporate and business objectives.

Define technology architecture, standards, and strategic priorities.

Evaluate emerging technologies and opportunities for innovation.

Provide technology guidance to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team.

2. Engineering Leadership & Product Technology

Lead Software Engineering and technology development organizations.

Establish engineering standards, development processes, and technical best practices.

Partner with Product and Design teams to deliver scalable products and platforms.

Improve software quality, development velocity, and engineering efficiency.

Ensure technology capabilities support evolving business requirements.

3. Enterprise Architecture & Infrastructure

Develop scalable enterprise and application architecture.

Oversee cloud infrastructure, networks, systems, and technology platforms.

Establish technology standards for scalability, availability, and performance.

Manage systems integration and enterprise technology dependencies.

Develop long-term infrastructure and capacity planning strategies.

4. Cybersecurity & Technology Risk Management

Establish enterprise cybersecurity strategy and technology controls.

Oversee security architecture, vulnerability management, and incident response.

Identify and mitigate technology, infrastructure, and information-security risks.

Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Risk teams on applicable requirements.

Maintain strong standards for data protection, privacy, and system security.

5. Data, Artificial Intelligence & Analytics

Develop the company's data and analytics technology strategy.

Oversee data platforms, data engineering, business intelligence, and reporting.

Evaluate and implement appropriate Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning capabilities.

Establish data governance, quality, security, and accessibility standards.

Use technology and analytics to support data-driven business decisions.

6. Technology Operations & Reliability

Oversee IT operations, DevOps, infrastructure, and technology service delivery.

Establish reliability, availability, monitoring, and disaster recovery standards.

Improve system performance, scalability, and operational efficiency.

Develop technology incident and business continuity processes.

Monitor technology performance and continuously improve operational excellence.

7. Innovation & Digital Transformation

Lead technology innovation and digital transformation initiatives.

Evaluate emerging technologies and their potential business applications.

Establish frameworks for technology experimentation and proof-of-concept projects.

Drive automation and modernization of legacy systems and processes.

Identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business efficiency through
technology.

8. Technology Organization Leadership

Recruit, mentor, and develop senior technology and engineering leaders.

Build and scale a high-performing global Technology organization.

Establish technology career paths, competency frameworks, and performance standards.

Manage technology budgets, resources, vendors, and strategic partners.

Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, security, collaboration, and continuous
improvement.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Software
Engineering, or a related field.

Master's degree or MBA preferred.

Experience

20+ years of progressive experience in Technology, Engineering, Software Development, or related
functions.

10+ years of senior technology or engineering leadership experience.

Proven experience leading large-scale Technology or Engineering organizations.

Strong experience with enterprise architecture, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, software
engineering, and technology operations.

Demonstrated experience leading digital transformation and technology modernization initiatives.

Experience managing technology budgets, resources, vendors, and strategic partnerships.

leadership.

added.description:
Company Description
Matrixport-NY is a technology-driven organization focused on delivering innovative digital solutions to a global client base. The company emphasizes reliability, security, and scalability in all its platforms and services. Team members collaborate across disciplines to create products that support data-driven decision-making and operational efficiency. Matrixport-NY values integrity, continuous learning, and a culture of experimentation to stay ahead in a rapidly evolving technology landscape. The organization offers a flexible, remote-friendly environment that supports professional growth and cross-functional collaboration.
Role Description
The Vice President of Technology is a full-time, remote role responsible for leading the overall technology vision, execution, and delivery across Matrixport-NY. This role oversees the design, implementation, and maintenance of technology platforms, ensuring they meet business goals for performance, security, and scalability. Day-to-day responsibilities include guiding IT strategy, supervising technology teams, prioritizing projects, and aligning technical initiatives with organizational objectives. The Vice President of Technology partners with senior leadership to drive strategic planning, evaluate emerging technologies, manage vendor relationships, and optimize resource allocation. This position also ensures strong governance, risk management, and compliance practices within the technology function while fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration.
Qualifications

Strong Analytical Skills to interpret complex data, evaluate technology performance, and support informed decision-making.
Deep experience in Information Technology, including infrastructure, applications, cloud services, and security best practices.
Proven ability to define and execute IT Strategy that aligns technology investments with organizational goals.
Demonstrated Project Management capabilities, including leading cross-functional teams, managing timelines, and delivering projects on budget.
Expertise in Strategic Planning, with a track record of building long-term technology roadmaps and transformation initiatives.
Leadership experience in senior technology roles, ideally at the Director or VP level, with responsibility for multi-disciplinary teams.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a remote, distributed environment.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in fintech, digital assets, or other highly regulated technology sectors is a plus.

added.title: Director of Information Technology
added.description:
Summary

A rapidly growing, mid-sized financial services organization located in Bergen County, NJ is seeking an experienced Director of Information Technology to lead and oversee all aspects of the company’s technology environment.
This is a stand-alone IT leadership role responsible for the strategy, security, reliability, and ongoing improvement of the organization’s technology infrastructure and business systems. The Director of IT will serve as the primary internal technology resource while managing relationships with third-party technology providers, including the company’s outsourced help desk and managed service partners.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on technology leader who can balance strategic planning with day-to-day execution. This individual will work closely with senior leadership and business stakeholders to ensure technology effectively supports operations, cybersecurity, regulatory requirements, business continuity, and the company's continued growth.
Responsibilities

Serve as the company's primary IT leader and internal technology subject matter expert, overseeing all technology operations, systems, infrastructure, security, and vendors.
Develop and execute the organization's IT strategy and technology roadmap in alignment with business objectives and future growth.
Manage the company's third-party Managed Service Provider (MSP)/help desk, establishing service expectations, monitoring performance, reviewing escalated issues, and ensuring timely resolution of technology problems.
Oversee the reliability, availability, and performance of the company's network, cloud environment, servers, applications, telecommunications, endpoints, and technology infrastructure.
Lead the organization's cybersecurity strategy, including security policies, access controls, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, incident response, employee awareness, and third-party security.
Maintain appropriate technology controls and documentation to support financial services regulatory, cybersecurity, privacy, and audit requirements.
Manage user access, identity and access management, permissions, and technology-related onboarding and offboarding controls.
Oversee Microsoft 365 and other cloud-based platforms, ensuring proper administration, security, licensing, and utilization.
Manage relationships with technology vendors, software providers, consultants, and other third-party partners, including contract negotiations, performance reviews, renewals, and service-level agreements.
Evaluate existing and emerging technologies and recommend solutions that improve security, operational efficiency, scalability, automation, and the user experience.
Lead technology implementations, upgrades, migrations, integrations, and other IT projects from planning through successful completion.
Partner with business leaders to understand operational requirements and identify technology solutions that improve workflows and business processes.
Develop and maintain disaster recovery, data backup, incident response, and business continuity plans, including periodic testing and documentation.
Manage IT assets, hardware/software inventories, licensing, warranties, and technology lifecycle planning.
Develop and manage the IT budget, technology expenditures, vendor costs, and capital investment recommendations.
Establish and maintain IT policies, procedures, standards, system documentation, and technology-related internal controls.
Support technology-related internal and external audits, regulatory reviews, risk assessments, and remediation initiatives.
Monitor technology performance, cybersecurity risks, vendor effectiveness, and emerging threats and provide appropriate reporting to senior management.
Serve as the escalation point for complex or business-critical technology issues that cannot be resolved through outsourced support.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
7+ years of progressive IT experience, including experience managing or leading an organization's technology environment.
Prior experience working in financial services, banking, insurance, fintech, or another regulated industry strongly preferred.
Demonstrated ability to operate as a hands-on IT leader within a lean or stand-alone technology function.
Experience managing MSPs, outsourced help desk providers, technology vendors, and third-party service providers.
Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, cloud technologies, networking, infrastructure, endpoint management, identity/access management, and enterprise applications.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, vulnerability management, incident response, data protection, and technology risk management.
Familiarity with financial services regulatory requirements, IT controls, cybersecurity frameworks, audit processes, and compliance standards.
Experience with business continuity, disaster recovery, backup management, and incident response planning.
Proven experience managing technology projects, system implementations, upgrades, migrations, and vendor relationships.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot and manage complex technology issues.
Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to executives and non-technical business stakeholders.
Strong organizational and project-management skills with the ability to independently manage multiple priorities.
Strategic, proactive, and service-oriented approach with the willingness to remain hands-on when necessary.
Excellent communication, leadership, vendor-management, and interpersonal skills.
